items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: I didn’t know anything from Billie Holiday at that time

ctx.x: [sings] “I’ll get by as long as I have you.” And I didn’t know anything from Billie Holiday at that time, but the songs I did, and “Once in a While” I sang it, I knew it, I liked it.
